name: The Aviator Aluminum Carry-On Spinner Suitcase
description: Precision-crafted from aerospace-grade anodized aluminum alloy with reinforced corner bumpers. Features ultra-whisper Japanese Hinomoto 360° dual spinner wheels, dual TSA-approved integrated combination lock latches, multi-stage aircraft aluminum telescopic handle, and waterproof compression dividers. Airline carry-on compliant worldwide.

name: The Nomad Full-Grain Leather & Ballistic Weekender Duffle
description: Hand-stitched with Italian vegetable-tanned full-grain leather and weather-resistant 1000D Cordura ballistic canvas. Engineered with a dedicated ventilated shoe compartment, padded 16-inch laptop compartment, solid brass hardware, luggage trolley pass-through sleeve, and a high-density ergonomic shoulder strap.

name: The Globalist Modular Compression Packing Cube & Tech Organizer Suite
description: A master 6-piece packing architecture engineered from ultralight water-repellent diamond-ripstop nylon and self-healing YKK dual-compression zippers. Includes 4 expandable garment compression cubes, a spill-proof hanging toiletry dopp kit, and an RFID-shielded passport and tech accessories folio.
